out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: 1) bee pollen
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT BEE POLLEN IS AN UNAPPROVED FOOD ADDITIVE. BEE POLLEN CANNOT BE ADDED ON TOP OF THE FOOD. PIC AGREED TO SERVE BEE POLLEN IN A SMALL CONTAINER THAT THE CUSTOMER CAN ADD ON TOP OF THEIR FOOD.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed multiple flying insects around the 3-compartment sink and in the office.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC STATES THE FACILITY HAS A LICENSED PEST CONTROL COMPANY. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO HAVE THEM TREAT FOR FLYING INSECTS AND/OR INCREASE SERVICES. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ELIMINATE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS, SPECIFICALLY ADDRESSING THE FLOOR DRAIN THAT DOES NOT DRAIN.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: 1) a container of nuts was observed being stored directly under a hand soap dispenser. Soap dispenser was located on the left side of the hand sink in the front. During normal hand washing procedures, water may drip onto the container of nuts
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. PIC MOVED THE NUTS OUT FROM UNDER THE HAND SOAP. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO MOVE THE SOAP TO THE OTHER SIDE OF THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER AND DIRECTLY ABOVE THE HAND SINK. PLAYA BOWLS (Inspection Date: 08/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed a floor drain next to the walk-in cooler filled with water. Upon discussion with PIC, floor drain does not drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAIR FLOOR DRAIN. FLOOR DRAIN MUST FUNCTION PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed spilled food on the floor of the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign posted at the hand sink by the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED A HAND WASHING SIGN TO PIC.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed multiple containers of food being stored in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. OBTAIN NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Multiple wet wiping cloths were observed being stored counter top in the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS IN A BUCKET OF SANITIZER. PIC MOVED ALL THE WIPING CLOTHS TO NEARBY SANITIZER BUCKETS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed wiping cloths being used to line a shelf for clean food preparation equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. REMOVE ALL TOWELS FROM SHELF. WET TOWELS WILL CONTINUE TO GROW BACTERIA.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: ice machine was observed with broken liner.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE REPAIR OR REPLACE ICE MACHINE TO AVOID PHYSICAL CONTAMINATION OF THE ICE.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Handles of the coolers and freezers were observed sticky to touch
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED. PLEASE CLEAN ALL HANDLES.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Tissue Supplied
violations.observation: Observed no toilet tissue in the bathroom closest to the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide toilet tissue at each toilet to minimize hand contact with fecal waste. PIC REFILLED THE TOILET TISSUE.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. There is no CFM present during the beginning of the inspection, CFNM arrived later during the inspection
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived later during the inspection PLAYA BOWLS (Inspection Date: 11/18/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition. No employee illness reporting agreement available during time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS provided a written copy to the PIC, PIC had employees red sign and agree to the illness reporting agreement.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: EHS observed milk being stored on the counter, not in a cold well or ice bath, without a 4 hour endpoint.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC marked containers of almond milk, soy milk, coffee creamer and coconut with a 4 hour end point.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. Observed no working thermometer in the facility during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC replaced the batteries on the thermometer

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: Observed no thermometer in 2 dr under counter prep top.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC placed thermometer in the 2 door under counter prep top

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHS observed buckets of kale, carrots, smoothie mixes and squeeze bottles of honey, Nutella, and almond butter without labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.PIC AGREED TO LABEL WORKING CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed containers of premade smoothies being stored on the floor of the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC agreed to acquire more storage racks for walk in freezer and to move the containers of smoothie mix off the floor.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. EHS observed employee handling food without proper hair restraints
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS spoke to employee about proper hair restraints. Employee then proceeded to put on a hat as a hair restraint.
